versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Feishu Mail Workboard skill.
- Automatically generates an offline HTML dashboard from the past 7 days of Feishu emails, highlighting key locations and tasks.
- Pushes daily interactive Feishu cards with overdue/approaching/attention reminders and Chinese summary translations.
- Includes easy setup, configuration guidance, and support for daily automation via a one-command install script.
- Supports previewing, dry-run validation, and flexible configuration through file or environment variables.
